links_touching_record.rationale: Implementation element FB2-SW-IMP-000001 is the code location in which FB2-SW-DSN-000001's acquisition, PEC-validation and publication responsibilities are carried: the pinned source's LTC_Trigger sequencer, its LTC_StartVoltageMeasurement command selection, its LTC_CheckPec per-LTC integrity gate and its LTC_SaveRxToVoltageBuffer reassembly into the published database block. The link runs from the implementation to the design because that is the direction master prompt section 13 declares for implements (implementation element -> design/requirement).

Static-analysis deviation record for FB2-SW-DEV-000002 (src/app/driver/afe/adi/common/ades183x/adi_ades183x.c) mined from the in-source Axivion MisraC2012 style-check suppression. Linked to the AFE driver architecture because that design element owns 'PEC calculation and validation' and 'SPI/DMA communication with LTC AFEs' and this suppression is the PEC buffer placement that those responsibilities depend on. Coverage is PARTIAL: the design element is titled 'AFE Driver Architecture (LTC Family)' and its implementation_mapping lists only src/app/driver/afe/ltc/*, so the ADI ADES183x driver is a sibling AFE driver the as_is design does not actually cover. Relation meaning: the deviation record refines the design element with an evidence-backed, code-level documented exception. The record is NOT a verification of the design element - it performs no test, produces no result and provides no coverage of any requirement. It documents an implementation exception observed in the code that implements the design element, so an auditor can see that the design element's implementation carries a recorded, justified deviation from the project's stated MISRA C:2012 compatibility requirement. The link asserts the existence of the recorded deviation only; it does NOT assert MISRA conformance, tool qualification, or a completed ISO 26262 or ASPICE assessment.

integrity.anchor_registry_note: The corpus provenance gate verifies each anchor against the file that anchor names and stores no registry-level digest of its own. This digest is recorded so a signature also pins which anchor set was in force.
integrity.verbatim_block_note: The block in section 3 is the file's decoded text with any single trailing newline removed, which is what the markdown fences require. `record_sha256` above is over the raw file bytes and is the digest a signature refers to; this one is over the text as embedded, so a verifier can compare either.

known_limitations_verbatim.value: Provenance re-checked 2026-10-01 after the source-registry repair. Anchors FB2-SRC-COD-000001 and -000002 previously named AFE_GetCellVoltages and AFE_GetCellTemperatures, neither of which exists; they now name AFE_StartMeasurement (afe.h:124) and AFE_RequestTemperatureRead (afe.h:131), which start a measurement cycle and request a temperature read. The revision history says 'Extracted from AFE driver source', and implementation_mapping asserts LTC_AFE_TriggerMeasurement, LTC_AFE_DMA_RxCallback, LTC_PEC_Calculate and LTC_6813_ReadVoltages are 'implemented'; graft grep finds none of those four names anywhere in the repository, and one of the two named source files (src/app/driver/afe/ltc/common/ltc_afe.c) does not exist. The extraction claim cannot stand, so the record is labelled derived.
